title: Convert the specification for publication by the WHATWG
body:
Converts the repository and specification from a W3C WICG draft report into a WHATWG Living Standard:

- Run `whatwg/spec-factory` (`Makefile`, `.github/workflows/build.yml`, `LICENSE`, `.pr-preview.json`, `.editorconfig`, `.gitattributes`, `.gitignore`, `.github/*`), move custom README sections to `READMEEND.md`, and remove obsolete W3C files (`w3c.json`, `LICENSE.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`, `.github/workflows/pr-push.yml`).
- Update `index.bs` metadata (`Group: WHATWG`, `H1: WebUSB`, `Shortname: usb`, translation links), add `#acknowledgments`, update `blocklist.txt` URLs to `whatwg/usb`, and resolve Bikeshed and `deploy.sh` lint checks.
- Keep `test/index.bs` in-repo (unbuilt) for now as reference until WebDriver BiDi automation is specified (#273).

Logos were added in whatwg/whatwg.org#522.

[Live Spec Generator Preview (`LS-PR`)](https://www.w3.org/publications/spec-generator/?type=bikeshed-spec&output=html&url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Falvinjiooo%2Fwebusb%2Fwhatwg-migration%2Findex.bs&force=1&md-status=LS-PR&md-Text-Macro=PR-NUMBER%20276) *(Note: `whatpr.org` reads `.pr-preview.json` from `main`, which lacks `LS-PR` until this PR lands.)*

Part of #271.
